items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1975-02-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, a session like Doc and His Patience, you had soprano then, didn't you? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. There was some soprano...

ctx.x: Well, I don't think there's much excuse for it actually. It is not bad as a solo instrument, although it's not as true as I like to hear an instrument. But of course there is no place for it in any kind of ensemble. And you know, the fact of the matter is that my own feeling about jazz, I really can't ever really get excited about solos. And to me, a solo or a vocal chorus is more or less an intermission. And it's not that I have anything against them, it's just that that's not the point where I'm listening. I'm…
Well, a session like Doc and His Patience, you had soprano then, didn't you?
Yeah. There was some soprano, although in some cases they were playing two clarinets.
